name: fantasy-command-center
description: Private ESPN fantasy football decision app with league-specific DvP, lineup, waiver, and trade analysis.

scripts.check: for file in src/*.js public/*.js extension/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('public/manifest.webmanifest','utf8'))"
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run secret-scan
